newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan gold rates seen easing on low demand.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan gold rates seen easing on low demand.

text.p: Pakistan gold rates are likely to ease on low demand because of a confused political scene this week after dipping last week, dealers said on Monday.
"Most major players are on the sidelines waiting to see the impact of political developments before taking fresh positions," one dealer said.
He said trading had been dull since President Farooq Leghari dismissed the government of Benazir Bhutto on November 5 on charges of corruption, nepotism and misrule.
Silver prices were unchanged, he said.
